missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Охота' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'На медведя' specifies the prey, and 'опасна' is the agreeing short adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Охоту' is the accusative direct object of 'любит'. 'С детства' tells how long he has loved hunting.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Охоты' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that hunting is not allowed. 'В этом лесу' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Охоте' is the dative form after 'к', marking what he prepares for. 'Заранее' stresses doing it in advance.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of interest. 'Охотой' is the instrumental form governed by 'увлекается'. It is joined by 'и' to 'рыбалкой', also instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Охоте' takes the prepositional form after 'на' to mean while hunting. 'Нужно быть осторожным' gives the advice.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Охоты' is the genitive form expressing the hunting season. 'Сезон' is the nominative subject, and 'осенью' gives the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive after после. 'Охоты' takes the genitive after 'после' to mark the time afterward. 'Мы вернулись домой' completes the action.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Охоты' is the nominative plural subject. 'Зимние' agrees in the plural, and 'трудными' is instrumental after 'бывают'.

missions.phrase: В этом году было несколько охот.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after несколько. 'Охот' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько'. 'В этом году' gives the timeframe.
